definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that a state continues or an expected action has not occurred. More formal than まだ.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}は{未|いま}だ{解決|かいけつ}していない。
examples.english: The problem has not yet been resolved.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}は{未|いま}だ{不明|ふめい}だ。
{彼|かれ}からは{未|いま}だに{連絡|れんらく}がない。
examples.english: I still haven't heard from him.

notes:
Also written as {未|いま}だ or {今|いま}だ. Used in formal writing and speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未|いま}だに: still (to this day)
- {未|いま}だ〜ない: not yet
